headline: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights, 2.8T parameters, 1M context
quote: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date.
claim: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro card lists a mixture-of-experts model with 2.8T total and 104B activated parameters and a 1,048,576-token context. It is released under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License, not a standard open licence.
why_it_matters: Far too large for any laptop; useful as an API or a licence/benchmark reference, and a sign of where open weights are heading.
title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro · Hugging Face

headline: Ricursive releases Ripple-65B Preview, dense open-weight coding model, Apache 2.0
quote: Ricursive Intelligence put a new open-weight coding model into public hands on November 4, 2026.
claim: Ricursive Intelligence released Ripple-65B Preview on 4 Nov 2026 under Apache 2.0, with a BF16 base model, an NVFP4 checkpoint and a DFlash2 drafter. Scores reported are 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (the model card says 80.52, self-reported).
why_it_matters: An Apache 2.0 65B dense coder with an NVFP4 build is a candidate for a local workstation or rented GPU; check independent benchmarks first.
title: What Ricursive Intelligence Released on November 4

headline: Nous Research posts Arete-27B, a Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune, Apache 2.0
quote: On our evaluation, Arete-27B raised its fact score from 2.32 to 2.98 out of 5 and cut answers containing propaganda from 22% to 0.9%.
claim: Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning only (about 52.8 million tokens at 64k context) to change its answers on politically sensitive topics; the card reports its own evaluation figures.
why_it_matters: A worked example of a small, SFT-only fine-tune with a published dataset and method, at a 27B size people actually run locally.
title: NousResearch/Arete-27B · Hugging Face
